name: Dixon Fat/Water Reconstructions
description: Validates that Dixon imaging produced both fat-only and water-only reconstructions (detected via ImageType).
implementation:
image_types = value["ImageType"].dropna()
image_type_strings = [str(it).upper() for it in image_types]

has_fat = any('F' in it or 'FAT' in it for it in image_type_strings)
has_water = any('W' in it or 'WATER' in it for it in image_type_strings)
has_in_phase = any('IN' in it for it in image_type_strings)
has_out_phase = any('OUT' in it or 'OPP' in it for it in image_type_strings)

if not has_fat and not has_water:
    raise ValidationWarning("Dixon fat-only and water-only images should be reconstructed. Could not identify fat/water images from ImageType.")
